item.title: The Palestinians stuck in the no-man’s-land of Jerusalem and the Israeli settlement plan to expel them
item.description: Tens of thousands of Palestinians in the Qalandia refugee camp and Kufr Aqab are cut off from Jerusalem by the apartheid wall and separated from other Palestinian towns. Now, a new Israeli settlement plan threatens to displace them completely.

item.title: How Jesse Jackson helped bring Arab-Americans into the political process
item.description: James Zogby talks to Mondoweiss about his late friend, Jesse Jackson, and his enduring legacy among Arab-Americans.

item.title: Trump appears to be gearing up to attack Iran. How close are we to war?
item.description: Donald Trump says he will decide whether to attack Iran within the next 10 days. Mondoweiss talks with Center for International Policy Senior Fellow Sina Toossi about Trump’s threats, Israel's role, and how Iran might respond if the US starts a war.

item.title: Pope Leo rejects Trump invitation to join Gaza ‘Board of Peace’
item.description: The Vatican flatly rejected a U.S. invitation to join the Trump-led "Board of Peace" for Gaza. The Latin Patriarch of Jerusalem previously described the project as "a colonialist operation" focused on "others deciding for the Palestinians.”

item.title: The night the protests in Iran were co-opted by outside forces
item.description: The nights of January 8-9, 2026, saw Iran go up in a coordinated blaze after two weeks of protests. I, and many other Iranians, witnessed the breakdown in public order during those days, and the influence of outside forces instigating the explosion.

item.title: Trump’s ‘Board of Peace’ reveals grim future the U.S. and Israel have planned for Gaza
item.description: The first meeting of Donald Trump's “Board of Peace” showcased the dystopian future the U.S. envisions for Palestinians. But even those plans might soon be eclipsed by Israel's renewed full-scale genocide in Gaza.

item.title: Trump’s ‘Board of Peace’ aims to turn Gaza into a playground for investors
item.description: A sweeping investment and reconstruction plan to transform Gaza's ruins into a playground for investors was unveiled at the first meeting of U.S. President Donald Trump’s "Board of Peace" in Washington, D.C., this week. Here's what you need to know.

item.title: Netanyahu and Israel are provoking the U.S. into attacking Iran — and the media continues to ignore it
item.description: As Donald Trump assembles a massive U.S. military force ready to strike Iran, the American media keeps ignoring essential context: Israel has been trying to provoke a U.S. war on Iran for decades.

item.title: How Israel’s genocide in Gaza has made it nearly impossible for this Palestinian teenager to manage her chronic illness
item.description: Shahd al-Afifi has a rare skin disease that requires a strict daily routine of constant moisturization, careful hygiene, and a humid, climate-controlled environment. The genocide in Gaza has made this impossible.

item.title: How data on the crackdown on Gaza protests reflects the increasing repression of activist movements in the U.S.
item.description: Data shows Gaza protesters faced harsher punishments than Black Lives Matter protesters did just a few years ago. Experts tell Mondoweiss this is the result of pro-Israel bias and a backlash against protest movements that has been building for years.
